findings.description: The join separator logic was inverted during the refactor. The original code used "; " when any_prefix_is_slash was true and " / " otherwise. The new code uses "; " when it is false and " / " when it is true.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with both primary and secondary opts, such as a boolean flag like --shout/--no-shout. Originally the non-slash case was joined with " / " ('--shout / --no-shout'). Now it is joined with "; " ('--shout; --no-shout'). Impact: help output changes for every boolean flag, and for slash-prefix options such as /debug;/no-debug the separator is also flipped.
